results.content:
UnleashX is an AI workforce platform that lets enterprises hire, govern and scale AI employees across their customer operations. Instead of standalone bots, every AI employee on UnleashX has a defined job, approved knowledge and access to the systems it needs, so work moves from the first conversation to a verified, recorded outcome.
Organizations can hire AI employees for roles like sales development, insurance sales, customer onboarding, support, retention, collections, claims intake, renewals, loan origination and recruitment. When a process spans several stages, teams can build their own workforce and orchestrate multiple AI employees that pass work and context between each other and to human teams.
